name: Cyber Story
source:
Plug into this incredible adventure of a robot girl in this visual novel. If you like anime stories, want to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of cyberpunk, and feel like an android, then this game is for you. You will find a story, like, 5 characters, a musical puzzle, a single location, and the most tamed fan service - in the best traditions of anime stories. Find your place in the new world, influence its fate, find out whether you are a robot or an ordinary girl, and find yourself. Get all the endings to get all the endings!

Do not worry about discomfort during your adventure, a simple and intuitive interface will allow you to fully concentrate on the story of the android girl. Controls in a visual novel is the same as in other anime stories. Just click on the screen, read the history of the robot and make a choice in certain situations. Be careful! Do not miss the important details and get ready for the music game. If you do not understand something, then use the hint.

During the reading of the visual novel about the android, you will discover achievements and additional materials that will allow you to enjoy the view of certain places and characters. The more secrets of the history of the robot girl you open, the more pictures you get! Do not forget to appreciate the music and sounds that will help immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the visual novel.

The game is completely free, so that every fan of anime stories can right away brighten up their evening by reading a new adventure. If you are ready, then do not make the android girl wait - help her get out of the terrible complex and reveal all the secrets of its owner. Do not forget to share your impressions and tell your friends about the robot visual novel. This game is meant for people who like pleasant reading, anime stories, and androids!

[From Itch.io (Page removed)]
translation:
接入这场机器人女孩的精彩冒险。在视觉小说中体验赛博朋克氛围，喜欢动漫故事、想感受安卓视角的玩家一定会喜欢。你将遇到一个故事、约5名角色、音乐谜题、单一场景，以及符合动漫故事传统、十分克制的粉丝服务。在新世界中找到自己的位置，影响它的命运，查明你究竟是机器人还是普通女孩，并找到真正的自己。收集所有结局，获得全部内容！

冒险过程中无需担心操作不适，简单直观的界面会让你专注于机器人女孩的故事。视觉小说的操作与其他动漫故事相同：点击屏幕，阅读机器人的经历，并在特定情境下作出选择。注意！不要错过重要细节，还要准备好音乐游戏。如果不明白某处，可以使用提示。

阅读这部关于安卓的视觉小说时，你会解锁成就与额外资料，欣赏特定地点和角色。打开的机器人女孩故事秘密越多，得到的图片就越多！别忘了欣赏音乐与音效，它们会帮助你沉浸在视觉小说氛围中。

游戏完全免费，每位动漫故事爱好者都能立刻用一场新冒险点亮夜晚。如果准备好了，就别让机器人女孩等待太久——帮助她逃出可怕的设施，揭开主人的全部秘密。别忘了分享感想，并告诉朋友这部机器人视觉小说。

[来源：Itch.io（页面已移除）]
